origin.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for origin, e.g. PIT for Pittsburgh.

destination.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for destination, e.g. LHR for London.

startDate.description: Start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. For Q1, use January 1st (e.g. 2025-01-01).

endDate.description: End date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. For Q1, use March 31st (e.g. 2025-03-31).
